National Stock Exchange of India Limited

Symbol: LTF  
 
 
 
                Security Code No.: 533519 
 
Kind Attn: Head – Listing Department / Dept of Corporate Communications 
 
Sub: Audio recording of investor(s) / analyst(s) meet – Q2FY2026-27 Financial 
Performance and Strategy Update 
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Further to our letter dated October 15, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A 
of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform the stock exchanges that the Company has uploaded 
the audio recording of investor(s) / analyst(s) meet for Q2FY2026-27 financial performance 
and strategy update held today, i.e. October 16, 2026 on the Company’s website at 
www.ltfinance.com/investors. 
 
We request you to take the aforesaid on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For L&T Finance Limited 
 
 
 
 
Apurva Rathod 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
 
Apurva 
Neeraj 
Rathod

by Apurva
